name: Quick Actions & Clock
description: Shared Home Assistant actions and optional clock for Kiosk dashboard, screensavers and Fotoo, with up to six items, battery icons, custom titles, linked sensors, Danish HA controls and per-item visibility rules.
author: Local Kiosk Satellite project

settings.title: Show on
settings.description: Permanent action visibility across dashboard, Kiosk screensaver and Fotoo. Party Mode remains a separate opt-in.

settings.title: Position
settings.description: Anchor point for the action rail, including centered top and bottom positions. Also configurable in HA.

settings.title: Layout
settings.description: Stack actions vertically or horizontally. Also configurable in HA.

settings.title: Button height
settings.description: Total button height (24–132 dp). Picture, padding, text and width scale together for compact dashboard actions.

settings.title: Show names and states
settings.description: Show friendly name and current state beside the picture. Also configurable in HA.

settings.title: Smart synlighed
settings.description: Hide away persons and inactive status-only indicators. Lights, switches, fans and action buttons remain visible. Explicit item rules take precedence.

settings.title: Item order & visibility
settings.description: Order first, then optional per-item rules after #. Example: 1,2,3,4,5,6 # 1=binary_sensor.motion|Active;3=sensor.lux|Numeric below|30

settings.title: Item 1 display entity
settings.description: Display entity (e.g. person.malte, image.aftensmad_lille, sensor.citroen_batteri). Append |Custom Name (e.g. sensor.citroen_batteri|Citroën) or | to hide label.

settings.title: Item 1 action entity
settings.description: Action entity (script, switch, light) OR linked sensor (e.g. sensor.citroen_batteri) to display percentage/state for a logo.

settings.title: Item 2 display entity
settings.description: Display entity. Append |Custom Name (e.g. person.dicte_hansen|Dicte) or | to hide label.

settings.title: Item 2 action entity
settings.description: Action entity (script, switch, light) OR linked sensor.

settings.title: Item 3 display entity
